summary: An ambient drone firmware: tapped keys latch drones that drift slowly into a large shimmer reverb with freeze, with an FM bell voice above and a bass voice below.
features: Drone voices mix detuned choir, additive partials and resonant noise
36 drone presets, three LFOs, 12 scales and in-scale chords
GLINT bells and BASS each have an arpeggiator or 32-step sequencer
The drone has its own chord sequence; all follow MIDI clock
Per-track MIDI channels over USB and TRS, with MIDI learn
16 scenes in flash shared with other firmwares; may overwrite their data
